fabricationFlags: City field is 'Calgary' but University of Lethbridge is located in Lethbridge, AB; Calgary is only the downtown pathway/satellite campus.
Pathway college named 'ULIC' throughout catalog; real name is UICC (ULethbridge International College Calgary), uicc.ca.

18 detailed UTP Stage 2 streams fabricated (Psychology, Sociology, Neuroscience, Fine Arts, New Media, Pre-Nursing, Public Health, Education, etc.). UICC officially offers only Foundation (UTP Stage I) and Business Administration / International Year One (UTP Stage II).
Pathway tuition wrong: catalog UTP Stage 1 = CA$17,500, Stage 2 = CA$19,500-21,500. Real 2026/27: Foundation = CA$21,090 (8 courses); International Year One = CA$24,193 (30 credits).
Per-degree tuition table (~70 entries, CA$16,500-25,500) has no verifiable source; all degree programs point to generic ulethbridge.ca homepage, no per-program URL.
Edmonton Campus listed as a third campus is fabricated; ULethbridge has only Lethbridge main + Calgary campuses.
Board of Governors' Admission Scholarship listed at 'up to CA$8,000'; official amount is up to CA$1,000.

ULethbridge International Entrance Scholarship (CA$5,000), ULIC Academic Excellence Award (CA$3,500), Dhillon School International Scholarship (CA$5,000), Indigenous Student Award (CA$4,000) — amounts unverified, likely fabricated.
sourceUrl is the pathway aggregator uicc.ca, not the official degree provider; confidence self-labeled 'aggregator'.
Accommodation residence names (Mount Blakiston/Kainai/Piikani House) and prices unverified; entries carry self-reported confidence 0.65.
evidence: ulethbridge.ca homepage confirms location Lethbridge, AB with main campus (4401 University Drive) plus a Calgary campus; no Edmonton campus and no Navitas/ULIC mention on the official homepage. UNews + Navitas press releases confirm the pathway is the ULethbridge International College Calgary (UICC), enabling progression to second year at Calgary OR Lethbridge campuses. uicc.ca/programs lists only two pathways: Foundation (UTP Stage I) and Business Administration (UTP Stage II / International Year One) — not the 18 streams in the catalog. uicc.ca fees page (2026/27): Foundation Program Fee CA$21,090; International Year One CA$24,193 — both higher than and inconsistent with catalog figures. ulethbridge.ca Board of Governors Admission Award page states 'up to $1,000', not the catalog's CA$8,000. Per-degree tuition and most scholarship amounts have no corroborating official source. Accommodation could not be verified against any official ULethbridge housing source.
